stages.choice_rule: Four unique lowercase words taken from the stem. Exactly one is a noun (person, place, animal, or thing). The other three are not nouns in that stem: a verb, an adjective or adverb, and a pronoun or little word. Never include two nouns. Never use a word that can be a noun and a verb in that stem. Vary answer_index.

gold_items.stem: The fluffy little puppy ran fast.

roots: Offer exactly four lowercase word choices. Exactly one choice is a noun. Never two nouns.
The noun is a person, place, animal, or thing from kid world: school, home, food, pets, play, family, weather. No brands.
Never use a word that can be a noun and a verb in that stem, such as play, drink, cook, or run as a thing.
Tier 1 distractors are a clear action word and a color, size, or feeling word. Add a picture lemma for the noun.
Tier 2 uses two-syllable nouns and mixes a verb with an adjective or adverb.
Tier 3 uses a pronoun (he, she, they, we, it) as a near-miss people-word, plus an irregular past verb or a place noun.
Do not put <NAME> and another person noun in the same choice set.
Never describe a picture in the stem. Never invent audio files. One tap. One right answer.

tier_rules.1: Short stems of four to six words. One obvious animal, food, or thing noun with a picture lemma. Distractors are a clear verb plus a color, size, or feeling word.
tier_rules.2: Five to eight words. Two-syllable nouns such as puppy, balloon, or a person name. Mix a verb with an adjective or adverb. Kid world only.
tier_rules.3: Near misses. Pronouns he, she, they, we, or it as tempting people-words. Irregular past verbs. Place nouns such as kitchen. Exactly one noun among the four choices.

noun_animal.en: A noun can name an animal. Cat, dog, and puppy are nouns.
noun_animal.ko: 명사는 동물을 가리킬 수 있어요. 고양이, 강아지, 새는 명사예요.

noun_thing.en: A noun names a thing you can see or hold. Soup, apple, and balloon are nouns.
noun_thing.ko: 명사는 사물의 이름이에요. 수프, 사과, 풍선은 명사예요.

noun_person.en: A noun can name a person. A name, sister, or friend is a noun.
noun_person.ko: 명사는 사람을 가리킬 수 있어요. 이름, 언니, 친구는 명사예요.

noun_place.en: A noun can name a place. Kitchen, school, and home are nouns.
noun_place.ko: 명사는 장소를 가리킬 수 있어요. 부엌, 학교, 집은 명사예요.

not_pronoun.en: He, she, they, and we take the place of a noun. They are not nouns.
not_pronoun.ko: he, she, they, we는 명사 대신 쓰는 대명사예요. 명사가 아니에요.

not_verb.en: A verb names an action. Sat, ran, and found are not nouns.
not_verb.ko: 동사는 동작을 나타내요. sat, ran, found는 명사가 아니에요.

not_adjective.en: An adjective tells about a noun. Red, little, and shiny are not nouns.
not_adjective.ko: 형용사는 명사를 꾸며요. red, little, shiny는 명사가 아니에요.

not_adverb.en: An adverb tells how. Quietly, fast, and away are not nouns.
not_adverb.ko: 부사는 어떻게 하는지를 말해요. quietly, fast, away는 명사가 아니에요.
